title: This Animal's Heart Stops Every Time It Swims
description: Octopuses have three hearts and blue, copper-based blood, and their main heart stops beating while they swim.

scenes.subject: octopus
scenes.text: Its blood is blue, and when it swims, its heart stops.

scenes.subject: octopus
scenes.text: Meet the octopus, an animal built like an alien.

scenes.subject: octopus
scenes.text: Two push blood through its gills to grab oxygen.

scenes.subject: octopus
scenes.text: The third, the biggest, sends it to the rest of the body.

scenes.subject: blood
scenes.text: Your blood uses iron, which turns it red.

scenes.subject: octopus
scenes.text: Octopus blood uses copper, which turns it blue.

scenes.subject: octopus
scenes.text: And when an octopus swims, that main heart stops beating.

scenes.subject: octopus
scenes.text: That may be why it usually crawls.

scenes.subject: octopus
scenes.text: and the strangest part of all:
